title: Model deployment protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Model deployment should complete this objective: Save, reload, and validate a complete pipeline. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Prepare a model for inference.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Record package versions and verify input/output contract; only reload trusted artifacts.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for joblib.dump, joblib.load, Pipeline and does not run the learner code. Record package versions and verify input/output contract; only reload trusted artifacts.
